maddeler.e:
ائتويت (form VIII)
# اِئْتَوَيْتُ (iʔtawaytu) /iʔ.ta.waj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
# اِئْتَوَيْتَ (iʔtawayta) /iʔ.ta.waj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
# اِئْتَوَيْتِ (iʔtawayti) /iʔ.ta.waj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
